text:
Dylan Holloway keeps scoring for a Blues team that has found its footing. Two goals and an assist in Friday's 5-3 win over Dallas made it 6 goals in his last ten games, and the Blues have won seven of those ten. He has 22 points in 26 games, and this time the chances match the scoring: 5.5 expected goals of his own over those ten games, with 9.6 on the season.

That's the change worth noting. Evolving-Hockey had him 20th among all forwards last season but flagged that his results ran ahead of his chances. This year he's shooting 14%, right in his expected range, and St. Louis takes 54% of the 5v5 expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on, nearly six points better than without him.

The tools fit the production. NHL EDGE puts his top speed in the 94th percentile, he has 58 hits, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him as a strong setup man last season. The one oddity: just 12.7 and 14.1 minutes in two blowout wins last week, back to 19 on Friday.
